text:
samira: quick thread about a URL handoff pattern for console deep-links. idea: let links target a subview (panel/tab/anchor) without forcing full nav or global tree expansion. wants feedback on focus/crumb behavior.
jorge: love it. quick question: canonical URL shape? path vs hash vs query?
samira: leaning to stable path + `?view=` + optional `#anchor`. e.g. `/console/datasets/88a7?view=activity#last-run` -> resource shown, activity panel open, jump to anchor. keeps breadcrumbs stable.
emily: accessibility: when we reveal a panel programmatically move focus to the panel heading and put `role=region aria-labelledby` so screen readers announce context. also update `document.title` or announce via `aria-live` to help users who monitor titles.
raja: routing: use `history.replaceState` to set `view` on initial reveal so back button doesn't get spammed, but `pushState` if user navigates inside the panel. sample: ```js
const u = new URL(location);
u.searchParams.set('view','activity');
history.replaceState({}, '', u);
```
emily: need focus return semantics: store the originating control in `data-return` before moving focus, then restore on close. keyboard users expect that.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) programmatic focus on reveal 2) focus visible styling 3) screenreader announcement 4) ESC closes panel and returns focus 5) skip links unaffected.
jorge: breadcrumbs should reflect the view: `Console / Datasets / 88a7 / Activity`. clicking the Activity crumb collapses the view. keep crumbs clickable.
samira: shareability: if someone pastes a link with `#last-run` we should support `?highlight=last-run` to pulse the element for a short time and supply `aria-describedby='shared-hint'` saying "Highlighted by link". low-motion users should get no animation.
emily: big perf note: pages with many cells/widgets should lazy-mount unrequested panels. if `view=activity` present, hydrate that panel first then other parts. use `aria-busy=true` while loading and don't scroll until content ready.
raja: edgecase: stale resource id -> wait for fetch then run open+focus. implement `deferredOpen` queue keyed by route so actions replay after data ready.
jorge: analytics: emit `nav.link_hand_off` with {resource, view, anchor, via_deeplink:true}. capture whether expansion changed state. useful to measure discoverability.
emily: keyboard flow test: tab into list, open view via link, focus should land in panel header, tab order continues inside panel, ESC returns focus. add SR script: expected narration 'Activity panel opened'.
samira: also normalize URLs: strip trailing slash, lowercase IDs, remove empty query entries to avoid duplicate share links.
a11y-bot: automated check: routes matching `/console/.+/:id` found. recommend a shared client util `applyDeepView(urlParams)` and a central focus helper `focusPanelHeading(id)`.
raja: feature flag suggestion: behind `console.deep_view_handoff` so we can A/B.
samira: i'll draft the spec with examples, code snippets, focus utilities, analytics schema, and an accessibility QA checklist. will open a PR in a bit. can folks review later today?
emily: yes, i'll take a11y review.
jorge: will look at router implications.
raja: I'll review perf and deferred queue impl.
a11y-bot: note: schedule accessibility smoke run once PR is merged.
samira: thanks all :sparkles:
